candidate_predicates.name: IS_PLAN
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explicitly expresses an intended future course of action — a sequence of steps or a single upcoming operation the agent intends to perform — rather than reporting already completed work.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text expressing an intended future action or an ordered set of intended steps.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least one action or outcome the agent intends to produce in the future.
The intended action is stated as something to be done, not as something already done.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports completed actions or observed results.
The reasoning only explains background knowledge without committing to a future action.

candidate_predicates.name: GROUNDS_CONCLUSION_IN_OBSERVATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning states a conclusion or interpretation that is supported by identifiable content of the observation, so that the observation functions as evidence for that conclusion.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning expressing the conclusion or interpretation drawn from the evidence.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation whose content supplies the supporting evidence for that conclusion.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a conclusion, interpretation, or generalized finding, not merely a restatement of the raw result.
Specific content of the observation is identifiable as the basis for that conclusion.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats or paraphrases the observation without drawing a conclusion.
The observation is unrelated to the stated conclusion or supplies no identifiable support.
The conclusion is derived solely from prior knowledge or from task instructions rather than from the observation.

candidate_predicates.name: RESOLVES_UNDERSPECIFIED_REQUIREMENT
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explicitly identifies an ambiguity, gap, or unspecified aspect of the given requirements and adopts a concrete interpretation or design choice to proceed, without the resolution being settled by observed evidence.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text recognizing the underspecified requirement and committing to a concrete interpretation or default.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least one requirement whose meaning, naming, or behavior is not determined by the task statement.
The reasoning selects or endorses a specific interpretation, default value, or behavior to resolve that gap.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely restates the requirement without noting any ambiguity.
The ambiguity is settled by an observed experimental result rather than by a chosen interpretation.
The reasoning defers the choice without adopting any concrete resolution.

candidate_predicates.name: TESTS_ASSUMPTION_WITH_PROBE
candidate_predicates.definition: A targeted action is performed to settle an uncertainty or assumption identified in reasoning, and the resulting observation provides interpretable evidence bearing on that uncertainty.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The action carried out as the targeted empirical test.

parameters.name: assumption_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that states the uncertainty or assumption being tested.

parameters.name: probe_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the outcome that informs the tested uncertainty.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific uncertainty or competing expectation that cannot be settled by reasoning alone.
The action is directed at producing the information needed to settle that uncertainty.
The resulting observation contains information that distinguishes between the competing possibilities.
exclusion_conditions: No identifiable assumption or uncertainty motivates the action.
The action is unrelated to the stated uncertainty or serves only to make progress on an unrelated step.
The observation does not address the tested uncertainty.

candidate_predicates.name: REPORTS_EXECUTION_ERROR
candidate_predicates.definition: The observation records that an attempted operation did not succeed, conveying an error status, failure message, or missing-resource fault rather than a valid result of the requested operation.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation conveying non-success of the attempted operation.

assertion_conditions: The observation carries an explicit error indication such as an error flag, failure message, or reported fault.
The error indication concerns the operation that was attempted, so the attempt is not confirmed as successful.
exclusion_conditions: The observation reports a successful completion or a normal result value.
The observation reports a negative fact about the domain state while the operation itself succeeded.

candidate_predicates.name: REMEDIATES_FAILURE_WITH_CORRECTED_RETRY
candidate_predicates.definition: After an error is reported for an earlier attempt, reasoning diagnoses the cause of that error and a subsequent action repeats the attempt with the identified cause addressed, rather than repeating the same attempt unchanged.

parameters.name: corrective_action
parameters.description: The repeated attempt whose invocation differs so as to address the diagnosed cause.

parameters.name: failure_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the error of the earlier attempt.

parameters.name: diagnosis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that attributes the failure to a specific cause and indicates how to correct it.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports an unsuccessful attempt of the same kind as the corrective action.
The reasoning names or clearly implies the cause of that failure.
The corrective action is a repetition of the attempt in which the identified cause is removed or compensated for.
exclusion_conditions: The retry repeats the failed attempt without any change addressing the cause.
No failure is reported for the earlier attempt.
The reasoning only acknowledges the error without identifying a cause that the corrective action addresses.

candidate_predicates.name: WORKS_AROUND_UNAVAILABLE_TOOL
candidate_predicates.definition: An observation reports that a required tool or command is unavailable in the environment, reasoning selects an alternative means to obtain the same information or effect, and a subsequent action performs that alternative.

parameters.name: alternative_action
parameters.description: The action employing the substitute means to reach the intended information or effect.

parameters.name: availability_observation
parameters.description: The observation indicating that the originally used tool or command is missing or unusable.

parameters.name: workaround_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that acknowledges the unavailability and proposes the alternative means.

assertion_conditions: The observation establishes that the original tool or command cannot be used in this environment.
The reasoning explicitly proposes a different means of achieving the same informational or functional goal.
The alternative action implements that proposed means.
exclusion_conditions: The observation shows the tool worked and returned a usable result.
The action repeats the unavailable tool or otherwise does not follow the proposed alternative.
The reasoning merely notes the missing tool without proposing or adopting a substitute.

candidate_predicates.name: MATERIALIZES_DESIGNED_ARTIFACT
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning contains a concrete specification of an artifact to be produced (such as its content, structure, or interface), and an action creates that artifact with content corresponding to the specification.

parameters.name: creation_action
parameters.description: The action that produces or writes the artifact.

parameters.name: design_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning containing the concrete specification of the artifact's content or structure.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning specifies concrete artifact content or structure rather than only a high-level goal.
The action produces an artifact whose content corresponds identifiably to that specification.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only states an intention to create something without specifying its content or structure.
The produced artifact's content does not correspond to the specification in the reasoning.
The action produces the artifact without any preceding specification of its content.
